mechanism_narrative: Accelerating residential confinement (RESIDENTIAL +4.3% at t-0w, up from +0.9% at t-3w) signals tightening restrictions that suppress retail mobility. RETAIL_REC will remain depressed or decline further over the next four weeks as movement constraints persist.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL increased 3.4 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days exceeds RETAIL_REC mean over last 28 days, or RESIDENTIAL stops increasing week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: Severe workplace collapse (WORKPLACES -49.6% at t-0w, down 30.3 points from t-3w) eliminates commuting-anchored retail visits and reduces discretionary spending capacity. This structural employment shock will depress RETAIL_REC for the next four weeks independent of policy changes.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES declined 30.3 points over four weeks
failure_condition: WORKPLACES recovers more than 15 points in the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC rises above its t-0w level within four weeks.

When TRANSIT falls below -35%, retail mobility cannot recover because the transport infrastructure required for discretionary shopping is unavailable. RETAIL_REC will remain negative over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: TRANSIT recovers above -30% within two weeks and RETAIL_REC subsequently rises above -20% within four weeks.

This behavioral shift toward minimized mobility will suppress retail-and-recreation visits as the same constraint logic applies across all discretionary categories over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM declined 10.4 points over four weeks
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM recovers above -5% within one week, or RETAIL_REC rises more than 5 points in the following two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Parks mobility remains elevated at +62.4% despite retail collapse, indicating outdoor activity substitution. When PARKS exceeds +50% while RETAIL_REC is below -25%, consumers are redirecting discretionary time away from enclosed retail spaces. This substitution effect will persist, keeping RETAIL_REC depressed for four weeks unless parks mobility normalizes.
failure_condition: PARKS mobility falls below +30% within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC rises above -15% while PARKS remains above +50%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint deterioration of TRANSIT (-41.3%), WORKPLACES (-49.6%), and RESIDENTIAL (+4.3%) indicates a coordinated lockdown regime. Under such regime conditions, retail recovery is structurally blocked regardless of consumer intent. RETAIL_REC will decline further or remain severely depressed over the next four weeks until at least two of these three indicators reverse.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT below -35 AND WORKPLACES below -40 AND RESIDENTIAL above +3
evidence_refs: fact:all three indicators at extreme values simultaneously
failure_condition: Any two of the three trigger conditions reverse (e.g., TRANSIT rises above -30 or WORKPLACES rises above -35) within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC rises above -20% within four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Parks mobility spike to +62.4% at t-0w suggests seasonal weather improvement or holiday period onset, which typically drives outdoor activity. If this seasonal pattern persists, it will compete with retail-and-recreation mobility for the next one to two weeks, suppressing RETAIL_REC as consumers allocate discretionary time to parks instead.
candidate_trigger: PARKS above +55 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at +62.4% at t-0w, elevated for three consecutive weeks
failure_condition: PARKS mobility falls below +40% within one week, or RETAIL_REC rises more than 8 points in the following two weeks despite sustained high PARKS mobility.

This risk-averse behavioral regime will persist over the next one week, keeping RETAIL_REC suppressed as the same caution that reduces grocery trips applies with greater force to non-essential retail.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC more than 15 points below GROCERY_PHARM
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC at -30.4% vs GROCERY_PHARM at -13.7%, gap of 16.7 points
failure_condition: The gap between RETAIL_REC and GROCERY_PHARM narrows to less than 10 points within one week, or RETAIL_REC rises above -20% while GROCERY_PHARM remains below -10%.
